jobs.title: Director, Customer Insights and Analytics
jobs.description:
The Director, Customer Insights and Analytics within Retail Risk team is responsible for leading the Canadian Retail Customer Insights and Analytics team. This role transforms customer, market, and behavioral data into actionable insights that drive business growth, improve customer experience, and support strategic decision-making. The Director partners closely with business leaders across Strategy, Product, Sales, Risk, Finance, and Technology to ensure customer-centric decision-making is embedded throughout the organization.

Key responsibilities include:

Build and lead a high-performing team of customer insight professionals, analysts, and researchers. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives on customer trends, risks, and opportunities.
Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Operational leaders to identify growth opportunities and improve customer outcomes.
Drive a customer-centric culture through data-driven decision-making.
Design and manage early warning framework with key risk attributes which align to macro economic indicators.
Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, retention, and profitability.
Lead customer segmentation, behavioral analytics, journey analytics, and predictive modeling initiatives.
Oversee quantitative and qualitative research programs, including surveys, focus groups, customer interviews, and market studies. Partnered with external agencies and user external data into meaningful results.
Translate complex data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop and maintain executive dashboards and reporting frameworks to monitor customer performance.
Establish KPIs to measure customer health, loyalty, engagement, lifetime value, and profitability.
Present findings and recommendations to executive leadership and governance committees.

Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in customer analytics, market research, business intelligence, or customer strategy. 5+ years in progressive leadership roles.
Strong knowledge of retail banking products
Excellent communication and articulation skills
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong knowledge of customer analytics tools and methodologies.

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $215,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

jobs.title: Associate Director, Insights & Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:

Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist

What We Offer

Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network

Overview

We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Associate Director, Insights & Analytics
to lead and scale our MMM capability across clients and internal teams. This role will shape the agency’s approach to marketing effectiveness measurement, guide clients through data requirements and model design, translate complex model outputs into clear business recommendations, and ensure MMM insights are embedded into planning, optimization, and investment decisions. The successful candidate will bring media strategy knowledge, measurement experience, client consulting skills, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners through complex analytics engagements.

Responsibilities

Lead MMM Capability: Own the development and evolution of the agency’s MMM offering, including model approach, data collection process, governance, delivery standards, and client-facing best practices.
Guide Model Design & Measurement Strategy: Partner with clients and internal teams to define business objectives, KPI hierarchy, brand/category structure, base versus incremental measurement needs, and testable hypotheses.
Oversee Data Collection & Readiness: Lead data requirement planning across media, sales, revenue, pricing, promotions, seasonality, macro factors, and other business drivers; ensure data inputs are complete, consistent, and model-ready.
Manage MMM Execution: Work closely with internal analytics teams, data science partners, and external vendors to support model development, validation, output review, scenario planning, and optimization recommendations.
Translate Outputs into Action: Turn model results into clear, practical implications for media investment, channel mix, budget allocation, flighting, diminishing returns, and future planning decisions.
Serve as Senior Client Consultant: Lead client conversations on marketing effectiveness, explain model methodology and limitations, present findings with confidence, and build trust with senior stakeholders.
Integrate Insights into Planning: Collaborate with strategy, planning, investment, performance, and client teams to ensure MMM learnings are connected to broader audience, media, and business strategy.
Build Tools, Templates & Standards: Create scalable MMM briefing documents, data collection templates, QA checklists, output interpretation frameworks, and executive-ready reporting formats.
Advance Measurement Thought Leadership: Stay current on MMM, incrementality testing, attribution, media effectiveness, privacy-safe measurement, and AI-enabled analytics to continuously improve the agency’s measurement practice.
Drive AI Capability Adoption & Development: Identify, test, and scale AI-enabled tools, workflows, and best practices that improve research, analytics, reporting, and knowledge-sharing across the agency.
Support Broader Research & Insights Needs: Contribute to research and insights work as needed, including new business pitches, category and consumer POVs, thought leadership, client requests, and cross-agency strategic initiatives.
Lead & Mentor Team Members: Support the growth of managers, specialists, and analysts by providing coaching, quality control, project guidance, and capability-building across MMM and analytics workstreams.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, media measurement, research, consulting, or agency/client-side analytics roles.
Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modeling, including model objectives, business use cases, data requirements, interpretation of outputs, and application to media planning and budget optimization.
Experience managing MMM projects end to end, including scoping, client alignment, data collection, vendor coordination, model review, delivery, and post-model planning recommendations.
Ability to translate technical analytics into concise executive narratives, clear planning implications, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Familiarity with paid media channels, including TV, digital video, social, search, display, audio, OOH, retail media, and CTV, and how these channels are measured and optimized.
Strong analytical fluency, with comfort reviewing data inputs, model outputs, response curves, ROI/ROAS, contribution, saturation, and scenario planning outputs.
Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint expected; familiarity with Power BI, SQL, R, Python, MMM platforms, or other analytics/statistical tools is an asset.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and workstreams while maintaining strong attention to detail and quality control.
Ability to lead through influence across strategy, planning, investment, analytics, and client teams.
Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience guiding team members and building repeatable processes or capability standards.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred; advanced degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field is an asset.
We welcome candidates with diverse career paths and encourage applicants who meet most of the qualifications to apply.

Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $80,000- 90,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Network Planning
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena is seeking a technical leader to direct the Advanced Network Planning group within the Navigator Network Control Suite Product Line Management organization. This leader will guide a team of highly qualified network analysts who support Ciena’s largest customers on tactical and strategic network planning initiatives. The role also shapes the Navigator roadmap by identifying emerging customer and market needs, directing research, and incubating advanced network optimization algorithms and tools.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead executive and technical engagements with Ciena’s global sales organization and customers, using deep domain expertise to guide the design, optimization, and analysis of optical, IP, and data centre network architectures.
Anticipate future network planning needs by synthesizing customer challenges, market insights, and technology trends, then translate those findings into prioritized research themes, product hypotheses, and planning tool concepts.
Set the technical research agenda for new network planning and optimization approaches, establish rigorous evaluation criteria, and validate the resulting methods through real customer network planning projects. Recent research areas have included forecasting, capacity planning automation, route and spectrum assignment optimization, failure analysis, and service availability modeling.
Define and communicate a compelling technical vision for advanced network planning, tailoring the message to align business leaders, customers, engineers, and product stakeholders.
Provide technical direction and partner with Product Line Management, engineering, and product development teams to translate validated concepts into scalable planning capabilities and bring them successfully to market.
Partner cross-functionally with hardware teams to model and analyze alternative network architectures, providing data-driven insights that influence product roadmap decisions.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of network planning experts, establishing technical standards, strengthening critical capabilities, and creating an environment of rigorous analysis, innovation, and continuous learning.

The Must Haves

15+ years of telecommunications experience spanning deep technical roles and positions with product, customer, or business leadership accountability.
10+ years expertise in optical and IP transport technologies, including network architecture, control, resiliency, capacity engineering, and optimization trade-offs.
Substantial experience in network planning, architecture analysis, optimization, and the application of analytical methods to complex customer networks.
Proven experience providing technical and product leadership for telecommunications software applications from concept and validation through productization, deployment, and measurable market adoption.
Experience with the use of AI tools as aids to software code development.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions across engineering, product, sales, services, customers, and executive leadership.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI-enabled methods to network planning, optimization, modeling, and decision support, with sound judgment regarding data quality, model validation, explainability, operational risk, and measurable customer outcomes.
Experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to accelerate software development, explore architectures, prototype algorithms, analyze networks, and improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate technical review and validation.

Nice To Haves

Experience developing, deploying, or governing AI and machine-learning technologies in telecommunications or other complex, high-availability environments.
Customer-facing experience relating to network consultancy services or similar.
Hands-on experience with Python or comparable analytical programming tools for prototyping, data analysis, optimization, or model validation.

The Salary Range For This Role, In Canada, Is

$154,000.00 - $246,000.00 CAD

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

Provisional Statement

This is a provisional classification. Formal regular review classification procedures may be initiated at any time by the incumbent or supervisor after the incumbent has worked a minimum of six months in the role.

About Dalhousie University

Dalhousie University is Atlantic Canada’s leading research-intensive university and a driver of the region’s intellectual, social and economic development. Located in the heart of Halifax, Nova Scotia, with an Agricultural Campus in Truro/Bible Hill, Dalhousie is a truly national and international university, with more than half of our almost 21,000 students coming from outside of the province. Our 6,000 faculty and staff foster a vibrant, purpose-driven community, that celebrated 200 years of academic excellence in 2018.

Job Summary

Dalhousie University, under the leadership of the Vice-President Research & Innovation, administers over $270M annually in research funding. Reporting to the Vice-President Research & Innovation, the Director, Research Facilities and Infrastructure Strategy leads the planning, governance, and sustainability of the University’s research infrastructure portfolio. The Director provides strategic leadership for the University’s research infrastructure, including shared facilities, major equipment platforms, digital research capacity, research computing infrastructure, and associated services.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the development and implementation of Dalhousie’s institutional strategy for research facilities, infrastructure, research computing, and shared research resources, ensuring alignment with university research priorities.
Advise the Vice-President Research & Innovation and senior leadership on research infrastructure investments, funding priorities, risks, sustainability, and long-term planning.
Provide governance and strategic oversight for shared research facilities and programs, including establishing service models, access frameworks, performance expectations, and sustainability plans.
Lead institutional coordination and strategic positioning for major research infrastructure funding opportunities, including Canada Foundation for Innovation ( CFI ) programs and other federal and provincial funding initiatives.
Coordinate cross-faculty and cross-unit planning with stakeholders including Faculties, IT Services, Facilities Management, Research Services, Finance, and external partners to advance infrastructure priorities.
Provide leadership for major university-wide research infrastructure initiatives, stakeholder engagement, and external partnerships that enhance Dalhousie’s research capacity and competitiveness.

Note

The successful applicant will be eligible for hybrid work (combination of in-person work on campus and remote work from within Nova Scotia) as agreed by all parties based on operational requirements and university guidelines.

Required Qualifications

Master’s degree with a minimum of seven years’ experience in research administration or related environment (or an equivalent combination of training and experience).
Demonstrated experience providing strategic direction and governance for shared research facilities, core facilities, major research platforms, or institutional research infrastructure programs.
Experience coordinating major research infrastructure funding initiatives, including proposal development, institutional positioning, and compliance reporting for programs such as CFI .
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder and cross-faculty initiatives requiring institutional coordination and strategic planning.
Strong analytical, financial oversight, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Experience advising senior leadership and developing institutional strategies, governance frameworks, and operational models that support research excellence and infrastructure sustainability.

Assets

Knowledge of digital research infrastructure, research computing, data management frameworks, and familiarity with the Digital Research Alliance of Canada.
Experience developing or managing research facilities, infrastructure programs, or capital projects in environments with elevated security, compliance, or regulatory requirements.

Job Competencies

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate proficiency in Dalhousie’s core
and leadership
competencies, in particular:
Self-Awareness & Professionalism
Integrity
Respect & Inclusion
Adaptability
Knowledge & Thinking Skills

Additional Information

Dalhousie University supports a healthy and balanced lifestyle. Our total compensation package includes a defined benefit pension plan, health and dental plans, a health spending account, an employee and family assistance program and a tuition assistance program.

Application Consideration

Applications from current university employees and external candidates are assessed concurrently. Current university employees will be given special consideration.
We sincerely appreciate all applications and note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly by the hiring department or People and Culture.

Dalhousie University commits to achieving inclusive excellence through continually championing equity, diversity, inclusion, and accessibility. The university encourages applications from Indigenous Peoples of Turtle Island (especially Mi’kmaq), persons of Black/African descent (especially African Nova Scotians), and members of other racialized groups, persons with disabilities, women, persons identifying as members of 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, and all candidates who would contribute to the diversity of our community. jobs.title: Vice President, Data Scientist
jobs.description:
BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service North American-based financial services provider, with over 2,700 professionals in 30 locations around the world, including 20 offices in North America, offering corporate, institutional and government clients access to a complete range of investment and corporate banking products and services. BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US$1.0 trillion total assets and approximately 54,000 employees as of January 31, 2025.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Cognition Team at BMO Capital Markets. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing and implementing advanced analytics and machine learning models to support algorithmic trading strategies, and drive business decisions in the front office, Investment Banking, and Corporate Banking. You will collaborate closely with business teams and other stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide insights that improve trading performance and profitability.

Our Team

The Data Cognition Team (DCT) at BMO Capital Markets delivers a scalable, customizable, and sustainable suite of AI-enabled products for multiple business units. Leveraging cutting-edge data and analytics technologies, we solve complex business challenges and drive strategic transformation across Investment Banking, Global Markets, and other divisions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement advanced analytics and machine learning models using techniques such as Generative AI, Deep Learning, and Reinforcement Learning.
Build predictive models for algorithmic trading across asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities, and Foreign Exchange.
Collaborate with trading desks, investment banking teams, and corporate banking stakeholders to identify opportunities and optimize strategies.
Research and experiment with new machine learning techniques, including time series analysis, to improve trading performance and profitability.
Design and maintain reproducible machine learning pipelines for production environments.
Analyze large datasets to extract insights and support strategic decision-making.
Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and present findings to senior management.
Visualize complex data clearly and concisely for business consumption.

Qualifications

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field (focus on finance, economics, or operations research preferred).
Minimum 3 years of experience in data science or machine learning; experience in capital markets is a strong asset.
Proficiency in statistical modeling, time series analysis, and machine learning frameworks.
Strong programming skills (Python preferred) and experience with cloud technologies.
Familiarity with financial tools such as Bloomberg, FactSet, and Thomson Reuters is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to formulate hypotheses and learn from data.
Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.
Team-oriented, adaptable, and detail-focused with a results-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

Experience with Generative AI and advanced ML techniques.
Knowledge of investment banking concepts, trading strategies, and financial data formats.
Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices for model deployment and monitoring.

What We Offer

Join our dynamic team at BMO Capital Markets and contribute to solving complex challenges in investment banking and global markets using innovative technologies. We offer opportunities for professional growth, access to cutting-edge tools, and the chance to make a significant impact on critical business operations. Apply today with your resume, highlighting your relevant experience in data science and finance.

jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. Job Description:

The Director, Platform Delivery is accountable for the delivery performance, capability, effectiveness and long-term sustainability of HR technology teams responsible for building, enhancing and evolving HR technology solutions. Working through a shared leadership model, the Director partners across Product Management, Technology Enablement and Strategy, Agile Delivery Leadership and HR Technology Operations to strengthen delivery effectiveness, develop people, build organizational capability and ensure assigned teams can successfully deliver agreed business outcomes.

What will you do?

Be accountable for the overall delivery performance, capability, effectiveness and sustainability of assigned teams.
Ensure teams consistently translate agreed priorities and technical direction into high-quality delivered outcomes with the appropriate capacity, skills, leadership and team structures in place.
Partner with Agile Delivery Leads to strengthen flow, planning, predictability, agile maturity and delivery effectiveness.
Use delivery evidence, team insights and performance trends to identify constraints, capability gaps and opportunities for improvement.
Build resilient, collaborative and effective teams with clear expectations for roles, decision making, collaboration, accountability and outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop Senior Analysts, Analysts and other delivery professionals; provide ongoing coaching, candid feedback, performance leadership, development planning and career guidance.
Lead workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance and talent development; identify capability or capacity gaps and create practical plans to address them.
Help individuals and teams adopt new technologies, roles, ways of working and organizational models while maintaining focus on delivery outcomes.
Partner across Product Management, Agile Delivery, Technical Strategy and Enablement, and HR Technology Operations to ensure the right people, capabilities, leadership and team structures are in place to achieve agreed outcomes.

Demonstrated success building healthy, high-performing teams and strengthening leadership capability.
Strong experience leading and developing people, providing feedback and supporting meaningful career growth.
Experience leading workforce planning, talent development, succession, recruitment and organizational capability building.
Experience leading teams through transformation, organizational change and new ways of working.
Experience using evidence and performance insights to identify delivery constraints and guide improvement.

Knowledge and capabilities in technology and platform delivery leadership; delivery performance, capacity and capability management; agile and product-oriented ways of working; high-performing team leadership; people leadership, coaching and performance enablement; workforce, talent and succession planning; organizational design and capability building; change leadership and adaptability; stakeholder partnership and influence; systems thinking, evidence-based improvement and continuous learning.

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
